BestResidualCandidates.meaning: residual placements, token masks excluded, present on every headline model

BestResidualName.value: dropout, before both residual adds, blocks 5 to 8

BestResidualAuroc.meaning: its mean AUROC at the adaptive rule

BestResidualGain.meaning: mean paired AUROC gain of PSBD-TM over the best residual placement

BestResidualGainLow.meaning: lower bound of the 95% bootstrap interval on that gain

BestResidualGainHigh.meaning: upper bound of the 95% bootstrap interval on that gain

BestResidualBadnetATwooAuroc.meaning: mean AUROC of the best residual placement on badnet_a2o, over 12 models, a dash when none is in the panel

BestResidualTactAuroc.meaning: mean AUROC of the best residual placement on tact, over 3 models, a dash when none is in the panel

BestResidualWanetAuroc.meaning: mean AUROC of the best residual placement on wanet, over 3 models, a dash when none is in the panel

BestResidualSigAuroc.meaning: mean AUROC of the best residual placement on sig, over 0 models, a dash when none is in the panel
